name: CompanyProof
short_description: Find legal companies, retrieve registry profiles and verify company facts with source evidence.
description: CompanyProof connects AI agents to company registry data and source evidence. Resolve a legal company by identifier and jurisdiction, retrieve its available profile modules, and verify supported company identity claims. The remote MCP uses Streamable HTTP with public tool discovery and authenticated data calls. Live data requires an eligible account and uses shared credits. Verification writes a proof and can enable eligible monitoring. Test access uses a documented fixture; coverage varies by company and jurisdiction.
authentication: CompanyProof Bearer API key for compatible custom clients

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find candidate legal entities by name, registration number, VAT number or ticker and country.
tools.cost: One shared credit per accepted live request.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Retrieve available company profile modules using the selected company ID.
tools.cost: One shared credit per accepted live request.

tools.name: verify_company_claims
tools.description: Verify supported identity claims, write a proof and optionally monitor eligible facts.
tools.cost: One shared credit per accepted claim; eligible scheduled rechecks use the claim allowance.

limitations: Financial and ownership modules are available where coverage permits and are separate from automatic claim verification.
Registry status does not establish trustworthiness, solvency or authority to act.
Ownership records do not automatically establish a calculated UBO determination.
Public beta; individual client end-to-end certifications are not implied by this metadata.
